messages.subject: changing line colors in plots
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am preparing graphs to submit for publication and am having difficulty setting the colors for the curves in the graph.

I have figured out how to make a nice black and white 'trace' graph using the following code:


plot(fit.pre, 
     type='trace',
     facet_items=T,
     par.strip.text=list(cex=.75), 
     par.settings = list(
         fontsize=list(text=16), 
         superpose.line = list(col="black",lwd=1),    # <-- This changes color of line from blue to black
         strip.border=list(col="black"),
         strip.background=list(col="gray95")),
     layout=c(4,6),
     theta_lim=c(-3,3), 
     auto.key=F,
     aspect=0.6666,
     main="")

However, when I use the same settings to make an 'infotrace' graph, all the information curves are blue. 

Can anyone suggest a solution?

Thank you.

Steven

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: changing line colors in plots
parts:
Hi Steven,

Sometimes lattice plots can be quite annoying. Worst case you can always extract elements for the object directly and build a custom plot (there some examples of this in the forum, in case you're interested). 

Fortunately, there's an easy global fix for this. Just run

trellis.par.set(list(plot.line = list(col = "black")))

before calling your plots and this will set all plotting lines to black by default. For some reason the col argument isn't getting detected when a 'group' input is omitted in xyplot() (maybe a bug?). Cheers.

Phil
